description: Number of users the storefront Users tab lists for the store (BIWW rows whose Znode user exists), all or of one role, market and status (Active = account not locked). Output userCount. Read only; count tests run serially. BMP-38.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode), e.g. BNJM

role.description: User Type as the grid shows it: Super Admin, Admin, Sales Rep or Market Coordinator. Left out: all roles

market.description: Market name; bind by reference, e.g. @market.marketName. Left out: any market, including none

isActive.description: true = Active (account not locked), false = Deactivated (locked). Left out: both

minUsers.description: Users the count must reach (at least), e.g. page size + 1 for paging cases. Left out: no lower bound
